_comment: Which database targets the preflight is allowed to point at.
A Supabase PROJECT REF is not a secret. It is the subdomain of the public API URL and ships to every
browser as NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, so recording it here reveals nothing that is not already public.
No key, password, or connection string belongs in this file.
The list exists so 'is this production?' is answered by comparison against a recorded fact rather than
by someone reading a hostname at 2am and deciding it looks fine.

productionProjectRefs.note: THE CURRENT PRODUCTION SUPABASE PROJECT. Permanently denied for staging operations. Any target resolving to this ref is refused outright, in every connection shape, whatever else the host or database name says - a database called 'staging' on this project is still production.
productionProjectRefs.doNotRemove: This entry is pinned by scripts/db-target-policy-verify.ts, which fails if it is deleted, unmarked, or no longer refused. Removing it is not a config tweak; it is disabling the one check standing between a staging command and the production database. If production genuinely moves to a different project, ADD the new ref and leave this one denied.

_stagingAllowlistNote: Refs positively identified as staging. An entry here makes a target STAGING regardless of whether its host or database name happens to contain a staging-looking word - which is the right way round, because a name is decoration and a ref is identity. PRODUCTION ALWAYS WINS: if a ref somehow appeared in both lists it would still be refused.

stagingProjectRefs.shapeAnomaly: NINETEEN characters. Supabase project refs are TWENTY (the production ref is 20). This is almost certainly a transcription error with one character dropped, so it probably does not match the real staging project at all.
stagingProjectRefs.note: RECORDED EXACTLY AS SUPPLIED, and deliberately NOT marked confirmed. If this ref is wrong, the real staging project will be classified UNKNOWN and refused - which is the safe direction, but it is also the direction that tempts an operator to loosen the check rather than fix the ref. Re-confirm the 20-character ref from the Supabase dashboard before relying on this entry.

_stagingNote: A target is only accepted when it can be POSITIVELY identified as staging. Absence of evidence that it is production is NOT evidence that it is staging - 'unknown' is refused, deliberately.
